webrtc-datachannel.description: Build CConnectionTransportP2PWebRTC, a P2P transport backed by an already-open DataChannel -- libdatachannel natively, datachannel-wasm on emscripten (same C++ API shape; see examples/blam/cblam-testing/WEBRTC_TRANSPORT.md in the coffeecutie repo). NAT traversal/SDP/ICE happen entirely outside GNS via application-level signaling; this does not use GNS's own ICE machinery.
